concurrency_reasoning.empty_observation: Count reads _count under the same gate used by Reserve and Release; zero denotes no occupied slot at that instant.
concurrency_reasoning.empty_then_reserve: A later reservation retains the original immediate Signal path. If its scheduling attempt is rejected, dirty/retry state and the admitted slot survive for a later nonempty timer tick.
concurrency_reasoning.lost_wake_and_lock_order: No dirty/scheduled protocol, context lifetime, slot release, nested lock order or callback-under-reservation-lock behavior changes.
concurrency_reasoning.release_or_dispose_during_retry: A prior positive Count snapshot only enters the unchanged full scan. Releasing the last slot can leave extra null checks; closure still rejects new reservations and stops the timer only once closing and empty.
concurrency_reasoning.timing_caveat: A reservation just after the empty check can miss this timer pass even if the former full scan might have reached it. It may wait for a subsequent tick after rejection; the configured period is not a strict wall-clock scheduling bound.

cost_limits: One extra reservation-gate acquisition per nonempty timer tick; active scan still examines full capacity.
Live Server retains its control slot from NativeHost construction until retirement, so this guard normally cannot skip its idle scans.
DataSource can be empty between operation retirements; any CPU reduction and latency effect require equivalent actual measurement.

existing_B04_route.native_diagnostic_export: nw_db_diagnostic_count_v1 is unconditionally exported in native/database/host/src/abi.rs.
existing_B04_route.postgres_start_stop: Original isolated TCP cluster; pg_ctl stop in finally after consumer launch; finite outer owner remains necessary.
